description: Weeks between dates the way The Comp Desk's CCP / Award calculator counts them: both end dates count; a period that starts the day the previous one ended counts that day once; a period held in abeyance counts no weeks; weeks rounded down to none / tenth / whole. Returns per period the inclusive days, exact and rounded weeks, whether the shared boundary day was dropped, and the next day after the end. Dates only, no money. New York State only. Computes with The Comp Desk calc-core, the same engine as the app and the Pro Workspace; it never estimates. A missing input returns status "missing" and nothing is calculated. Returns the figures, the steps with the rule and engine function behind each, and the not-legal-advice notice.
name: calculate_benefit_weeks
title: NY benefit weeks between dates
